thread:
tanya_cs: Morning — kicking off Ember onboarding. Short sprint-0 (10 days) goals: onboard Redwood Hosted into Ember support workflow, run a 10-sample latency+quality check, and run a Console enablement session for their CSMs. Who volunteers for owners?

omar_pm: I'll be PM contact from Ember. Weekly sync Fridays 8am PT. I'll loop in Sylvia (SRE) and our compliance lead after this.

sylvia_sre: Sylvia (Ember SRE). We need to confirm data residency (EU) and whether Hosted meets our controls; we may require a Private deployment for FedRAMP-like controls. Also webhooks must be signed.

maddie_success: I'll own success criteria and capture acceptance tests. Proposed acceptance: (a) staging E2E ticket flow validated, (b) 95th p95 latency <350ms on the sample set, (c) CSMs run the Console playbook and submit checklist. Note: if go-live slips past Day 21 mark renewal-risk and escalate to AM.

kevin_se: I'll own integration pairing and model tuning. Need: 10 anonymized tickets, example webhook payloads, and staging API key. I'll provide a smoke-test repo and a small Node/TS example.

onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist: /docs/onboarding/ember-checklist — includes Console playbook, API quickstart, security questionnaire.

tanya_cs: Action items: 1) omar to intro sylvia + compliance by EOD; 2) Ember to provide 10 anonymized tickets + sample payloads Day 2; 3) kevin to post smoke-test repo Day 1-2; 4) maddie to draft acceptance tests Day 2; 5) I'll create the sprint board and invite owners today. Also please flag any legal/infra gating items now.

omar_pm: Intro sent. Compliance asked for a short controls matrix — I'll share that and ask if Private deployment is needed.

sylvia_sre: Opening an internal infra ticket for webhook signing + IP allowlist. ETA 48h. If Private required, we need cost estimate and timeline.

kevin_se: Quick curl sanity check to share with their engs:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"input":"Summarize the ticket: <body>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maddie_success: I'll confirm region routing and fallback options for EU by tomorrow and add notes to the sprint board. If Private required, I'll draft a high-level delta for ops and cost.

tanya_cs: Scheduling first sync Fri 8am PT. Small ask: after first 48h ask their CSMs to try the Console runbook and report anything confusing so we can iterate. :sparkles:

omar_pm: CSMs will join the runbook session. Thanks all, excited to get started.

(onboarding thread closed)
